assumptions.source: <the input concept verbatim: the directed sentence's concept, a surfaces[].name, a flow, or 'baseline rule' - NEVER a file name: only metadata.inputs may cite files>

model_roles.statefulness: none|session|durable - durable is MANDATORY when any trigger holds: cross-session continuity, a human-approval-gate pause bound to the role (checked), a shared blackboard/audit trail whose concept must already sit in persistence.data_model (checked), long-term semantic recall
model_roles.memory_technique: sliding-window|rolling-summary|semantic-episodic - REQUIRED with session/durable, forbidden with none; semantic-episodic requires a retrieval-scope-guard capability (checked)
data_classes: <persisted concept or data class names, from the strategy/slice, verbatim>

capabilities.surface_or_flow: <a strategy surfaces[].name or a context-map flow, copied VERBATIM - the join key>
roles: <optional: model_roles ids this rule binds - every agent in a topology must be an agent in the plan>

measurement.assertion: <what a stage-1 test observes against the STUB port - never a model's wording, never a clock>

invariants.rule: <worst-case law, one sentence; one MUST state that no test path reaches a live endpoint>
invariants.capability: offline-model-port|loop-budget-cap|<another closed token; an agent-handoff topology MUST have a loop-budget-cap invariant here>
roles: <optional: model_roles ids this law binds - a loop-budget-cap names exactly the AR- agents whose cycle it caps>

duties.spec_ref: AC-01|AM-01 (ONLY rule rows - roles and assumptions carry no capability to match; cite AR-/AA- inside the obligation text, never as the duty target)
duties.obligation: <one sentence: what a unit must hold>
duties.capability: <the SAME closed token as the rule it discharges>

risks.mitigation: <an id this spec declares> OR accepted:|none:|operator:|out-of-scope: <posture>
risks.residual: <what stays exposed; required for accepted postures>

open_questions: <anything the inputs never declared - an entry here STOPS the run>
